# Vendored: toml++ (tomlplusplus)

- **File:** `toml.hpp` — the official single-header amalgamation.
- **Version:** v3.4.0 (see TOML_LIB_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH in the header).
- **Source:** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marzer/tomlplusplus/v3.4.0/toml.hpp
- **License:** MIT (full text embedded at the top of `toml.hpp`).

Do not edit `toml.hpp` by hand — it is generated. Header-only: no extra source
entry in `ext.pathlike.toml` is needed. To update, drop in a newer release
amalgamation and rebuild.
